Tests: a target that is not HTML, from the malformed input list of spec
section 15.

This file exists so that the loader can be asked to open something it cannot
audit and can be seen to refuse with a sentence rather than a traceback. It
contains no markup at all, which is the point: the loader sniffs for a tag
rather than trusting the file extension, because a saved DOM is routinely
called .txt and a .html file is routinely a renamed image.

Nothing here should ever be parsed as a page.
